events.action: A prosecution witness said the defendants were classified as highly dangerous (risk level 5 of 5); several witnesses knew little about their backgrounds.
The entry team frisked the defendants on their beds in a partly lit room, declared it clear, and did not search for weapons.
The defendants were removed from the room on a decision made in advance by the ground commander, though an officer agreed there was no danger once they were secured.
The search team brought the defendants back after several minutes and described the firearm and grenade as very obvious.
D1 testified that 15 to 20 minutes passed and that the weapons were on her bed when she was brought back; both defendants deny the weapons were theirs.
The defendants said the funds in the room came from a fundraiser.
